rubric.note: Improved: three walnut diaphragm arches now spring from the side walls and curve across the nave (hero y 25-160), replacing the two straight beams, and four wall sconces give the long side walls a rhythm. The apse, the three pointed lancets, the stepped altar and the gear chandelier on the axis still compose well. The geometry did change this time: low 8,757 to 11,969 tris, high 67,501 to 63,804, GLB 756,540 to 891,148 bytes. Still open: behind the arches the ceiling is the same flat plank deck, and there is no vault or rib over the apse (the builder confirms the apse keeps its plain barrel soffit). The apse is still a shallow stone-faced slab with a pointed opening, not a recessed bay. There is still no dais: report.json colliders are unchanged, the altar tops out at y 1.36 and the four braziers at 1.41 (D1).

Structurally unchanged. The guardian position is still flat floor inside a thin brass ring inlay, with no raised or enclosed fighting ground. Brighter light helps the ring read: the ring interior is luma 72.1 against 61.1 on open floor (lightmap-only frame: 61.1 against 53.3), and the stained-glass patches now land inside it (arena crop). The aisle inlays, brazier pillars, chandelier and arches all converge on the shrine. Read cold, it is still a well-lit chapel with a shrine rather than a boss arena.

Fixed: the faceted pyramid flames are now teardrop cards. Improved: on the brass mask the wall gears read 118,84,38 (hue 34.3, G/R 0.71), up from hue 29 and G/R 0.60. They are still short of #DEC16A (hue 45, G/R 0.87). New runtime fault: the apse oculus gear (now brass-polished) went from grey to bleached ivory. It reads 134,110,87 (luma 113.5, saturation 0.35) against 72,43,16 lightmap-only and 74,45,17 in Blender, so blue rises from 16 to 87 and luma rises 2.4x. In the reward-eye shot it is the palest metal in view (117.3 luma), bone-coloured, not brass (oculus crop). The chandelier is better than v3 but still washed out: 133,96,63 (saturation 0.53) against 144,94,42 (0.71) lightmap-only. Worse: the centre-lancet gilt mullion is now luma 131.8 against glass at 68-69 at the reward eye, up from 111 against 72. In the hero shot the runtime lifts it to 81.2, against 54.6 lightmap-only. The engine flames render as thin slivers: some cards are edge-on or missing. On a flame-colour mask they cover 1,282 and 1,577 px against 1,527 and 1,781 in Blender for the same camera, and the Blender frame shows full teardrops. Where they do show, they are flat, hard-edged lemon shapes with no core-to-tip gradient. Lightmap density dropped to 39.61 mean and 32.61 minimum px/m (from 42.63 and 35.99), against 66.3 for the study. D2 still records ~43. Stone, damask and floor stay crisp and in the kit's language.

Fixed: overall value. The hero frame mean is luma 54.8, up from 33.7, with the in-game study at 56.1 (p5-int-study.jpg). The re-shot study engine.hero is 28.2, so the vault is now brighter than its like-for-like reference. Wallpaper reads 39.5 (far left), 43.1 (mid) and 66.8 (near the sconce) in the hero, and 56.6 at the reward eye. The study measures 36.8-65.1 in its engine hero and 42.6-63.4 in-game. The sconces make real pools and the brazier foot stays brighter than open floor (83.5 against 61.1). Clipping is 0.05% of the frame. Still open, and worse: flame warmth is lost at runtime. On the flame mask, the engine reads 215,179,124 (R-B 92, saturation 0.43) against 246,184,97 (R-B 149) lightmap-only and 248,202,108 (R-B 140) in Blender. That is a 38% loss of R-B (v3: 20-25%), and the flames read pale cream instead of candle amber #F3BE65 (R-B 142). The sconce hotspots also desaturate at runtime: the brazier-camera sconce box reads saturation 0.33 against 0.43 in Blender, and it looks pinkish. A cool cast sits on the apse lintel walnut: blue 35 against 12 lightmap-only. The art bible allows no cool ambient fill. I saw no black areas apart from the sealed far door of the corridor in the seam-south shot (proof-path cap, not penalised).

rubric.criterion: readability and comfort at seated VR distance
rubric.note: The single strong axis, the open floor and the brighter side walls keep the guardian and reward positions obvious and the room's width readable when seated. Deductions: at the reward eye-point, the flat lemon flame cards on both frame edges are still the brightest hard-edged shapes at eye height (luma 168-189, max 246). The pale mullion (131.8 against glass at 69) splits the focal window directly behind the reward.

topFixes: Fix the runtime material path for emissive and polished parts. Today the engine strips the warmth that the lightmap-only and Blender frames keep. The flames show R-B 92 in the engine against 149 lightmap-only. The brass-polished oculus gear shows 134,110,87 against 72,43,16. The gilt centre mullion shows 131.8 against glass at 69, and the sconce hotspots show saturation 0.33 against 0.43. Exempt the flame/emissive slot from the probe and tone-mapping desaturation, or pre-compensate it. Give polished brass a warm in-room environment so it lands near #DEC16A, not ivory. Dull the mullion to the walnut frame value.

Make the flame cards render as full soft teardrops in three.js. They currently show as edge-on slivers covering 84-89% of the Blender flame area for the same camera, so check double-siding and the crossing. Give them an alpha falloff and a hotter core so they stop reading as flat lemon shapes at the reward eye-point.

Turn the shrine into an arena. Raise a stepped dais under the guardian socket, which needs the src/content/rooms.ts socket change that D1 leaves to Paul. Carry the new diaphragm arches into the apse as ribs, or a groin vault over the shrine, instead of the flat plank deck and plain soffit. While rebaking, update D2 to the built 39.6 px/m or zone-weight the lightmap toward the apse and floor ring.
independentScoreHistory.method: Judged the engine frames first and weighted them; used the Blender lightmapped and Cycles renders and the three.js lightmap-only frame to separate bake from runtime problems. Viewed in full all six docs/verification/p5-rooms-guardian-vault-*.jpg, the review sheet, the study engine.hero (re-shot at 60cff33) and p5-int-study.jpg. Made Pillow crops at 2-4x of: the oculus gear (engine, lightmap-only and Blender side by side), the brazier flames (engine and Blender), the reward-eye flames and centre lancet, the chandelier, the sconces, the ceiling arches and the guardian ring. With numpy, measured the sRGB mean, Rec.709 luma, HLS hue, G/R, R-B and HSV saturation in identical pixel boxes on engine.hero, engine.hero.diffuse, hero.lightmapped and hero.reference-diffuse, plus the reward-eye and brazier frames. Masks: brass G/R>0.55 with L>35; flames R>170, G>130, R-B>60, L>150. The full-res PNGs match the docs JPGs with mean absolute difference 3.0, which is JPEG noise. Compared frame and wallpaper luma against the study engine hero (28.2) and in-game (56.1). Read the art bible, report.json (11,969/63,804 tris; density 39.61/32.61 px/m; colliders unchanged; clipped 0.99%), engine-compare.json (frame ratio 0.903, RMSE 0.0429; engine hero mean 54.0), uv1-report.json (0 px overlap, min gap 16 px, 1.0003 claims per texel) and provenance.json (previous independentScore 76 at ac21f3b; D3 and D6 revised, D1 and D2 unchanged). Treated rebake2-status.md as claims. Confirmed: brighter wallpaper (it claims 50.4; I measure 39.5-66.8 by box), arches, sconces, teardrop flames, gilt hue (39.8 on its stricter mask; 34.3 on mine). Disputed: the oculus gear 'hue 35, luma 175' does not read as brass, because on my mask it is saturation 0.35, ivory. Not credited: the self-score of 81. Did not run any build or edit any repo file.

independentScore.method: Independent change review against the previous five-criterion rubric. Examined the supplied 1280x720 capture at full resolution and the window apex in a 3x nearest-neighbour crop. The hero JPG listed in evidence is the previous build and was checked for historical context only. The wider room criteria retain the previous assessment wherever the fresh images cannot establish a change. The staged GLB hash matches its reimport, UV and bake reports, the compressed lightmap hash matches the bake report, and reimport passed all listed checks. UV report records zero overlapping pixels. No new room-wide capture, animated sequence, physical Quest measurement or owner sign-off is part of this review.
